violated_contract: A cap that bounds concurrent state must not be able to become a permanent block. When the only path that releases an entry is a later admission attempt, and admission is refused once the cap is reached, the cap converts a bounded resource into a deadlock: the owner can never admit again and the entries can never be released. The bound must be reachable from a path that does not itself require admission.
canonical_prevention: Release the entry on the terminal outcome that makes it unnecessary, before the destructive step that would otherwise erase the only retry handle, and let a full ledger run the existing settlement pass once before refusing admission. Reproduce a ledger at the bound and prove it can release and admit again.
